verdict.rationale: Media engines and creator-app acceleration are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only AI/HPC capabilities for the H200: HBM3e memory, MIG, LLM inference, CUDA and HPC SDKs. Nothing in it covers AV1/HEVC encode or decode hardware, creator-app acceleration, or professional/ISV-certified drivers, and the generic RTX/OpenUSD platform mention is not tied to this product's media engines.
